items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I got mad at the Snoop, he's a policeman here now. ... he tried to get some quick money and give him some old alcohol... made him sick, and made me mad

ctx.x: Way to, way to, I got water in the fridge to do.

And, you know, I just, I like Lonnie Johnson, his brother, Sturdy Roll. Sturdy Roll, yes. Sturdy Roll, yes. Yeah. Well, see me and Sturdy Roll used to, I, I jumped on a boy, he's police here now, about getting him some alcohol, made him sick so he, we couldn't make a Sunday evening party, which I wanted that three and a half, you know. And me and Sturdy Roll was getting the same dollars. That was a lot of money at that time.
